name: akou
description: akou turns audio into text on your own server. A program uploads a file and reads back the text with word and segment times and speaker labels, as JSON, SRT or VTT, by long-poll, an event feed or a signed webhook. It also answers the OpenAI transcription endpoint. A web page shows the job queue, the API keys, the models and the settings. It is the server mode of akou, a call recorder for macOS, with the same core.
short_desc: Self-hosted transcription server with speaker labels and an OpenAI-compatible API.
author: GeiserX
